description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and the absolute mean of the hidden state. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4.5, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A dashed blue line, labeled “hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”, begins at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, decreases to a minimum of approximately 0.1 at layer 2, then increases to approximately 0.3 at layer 10, and rises sharply to approximately 4.2 at layer 21. A dotted orange line, labeled “hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”, starts at approximately 0.04 at layer 0 and remains relatively constant at around 0.04 to 0.08 until layer 21, where it increases to approximately 0.1. A solid green line, labeled “hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”, begins at approximately 0.04 at layer 0 and increases gradually to approximately 0.1 at layer 21.
